thread:
eli: Heads-up — we're hitting a conflict on the roadmap: Dedicated Model X rollout wants the new GPU pool the infra team plans to refactor. Need a fast cross-func decision so both teams can plan. Can we get a 30m sync this week? Prefer Thu morning. cc @rachel @marta @sam

rachel: Thu morning generally works for me. Is this just a schedule alignment or do we need to decide to postpone one of the two workstreams?

eli: The crux is sequencing. If infra refactor blocks GPU availability for 2 weeks, we should either delay the canary or use burst capacity (higher cost). Need to agree on criteria: cost vs. risk/time-to-market.

marta: Quick note — if we delay Model X canary 2 weeks we miss the enterprise pilot window. That would push revenue timing. I'm leaning to finding temporary capacity and doing refactor post-canary.

sam: I'm neutral but need to lock on automation work. If we go with temporary capacity, I'll need ops support for the fast path (temp pools + firewall rules). Thu 09:30-10:00 PT works for me.

eli: OK, options: A) Temporary capacity + canary (higher $) B) Pause canary until refactor done (protects cost/infra) C) Split: run limited internal canary now, full public canary after refactor.

rachel: Can we add rubric items to the agenda: user impact, SLA risk, cost delta estimate, and rollback story? Also want to capture decision rationale in the decision log (so sales/customer-facing folks have context).

eli: Agreed. Agenda draft: 1) Quick context (5m) 2) Risks & metrics (10m) 3) Tradeoffs + cost estimates (10m) 4) Decision + owners + next steps (5m).

marta: @eli can you drop a short cost delta for option A vs C before the meeting? Even a back-of-envelope number is helpful.

eli: Will do. Rough numbers now: temp capacity ~+$4k/week; limited internal canary ~+$1k/week. I'll update with infra's burn estimate.

sam: I can prep a short runbook stub for temporary pool setup and firewall exceptions. Pushing to the thread: ```
# Temp pool steps
1. Request N GPU nodes via infra self-serve
2. Apply customer VPC firewall rule scope
3. Add canary config -> dedicated tag
```

rachel: Nice. Also adding a pre-read link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321 (infra refactor RFC) and model playbook doc: https://share.redwood.com/model-x/playbook

eli: Polling real quick — react with :one: for Thu 09:30-10:00, :two: for Thu 13:00-13:30, :three: for Fri 10:00-10:30

marta: :one:

sam: :one:

rachel: :one:

eli: Looks like Thu 09:30 wins. @agenda-bot please create a calendar event for Thu 09:30-10:00 PT, include agenda and links above. Also can someone volunteer to write the decision log entry? We should capture chosen option + why, owners, and rollback steps.

marta: I can own the decision log and write a 1-paragraph rationale after the meeting.

agenda-bot: Event created: Cross-func roadmap arbitration — Thu 09:30-10:00 PT. Agenda and pre-reads attached. Attendees: eli, rachel, marta, sam.

eli: Thanks all. See you Thu — I'll post the cost delta and a one-pager for the risk section by EOD tomorrow.

marta: Added: please flag any other stakeholders ASAP (security, sales).

sam: Will ping infra on the temp pool ETA and post here.

agenda-bot: Reminder: please add any additional agenda items by Thu 08:00 PT.
